title: Annotatio IV §.V: Spirit witnesses — Spirit is truth; Spirit quickens; words are Spirit and life
pass_a_gloss: Yet He performed that very thing in this manner, that the Spirit should be the one bearing witness that the Spirit is the truth (1 John 5:6 coll. with John 6:63) — i.e. that the Spirit should have testified that the Spirit is Truth, that the Spirit also quickens, and that Christ’s words concerning participation of His Body and Blood are Spirit and life.
pass_b_english: He did it so that the Spirit should bear witness that the Spirit is the truth (1 John 5:6 with John 6:63).
The Spirit is Truth; the Spirit quickens; Christ’s words on participating His Body and Blood are Spirit and life.
source_text: Tamen id ipsum præstitit hunc in modum, ut to pneuma fuerit to martyroun hoti to pneuma estin hē alētheia, Joh. 5. v. 6. coll. cum Joh. cap. 6. v. 63. h. e. ut Spiritus testatus fuerit, Spiritum esse Veritatem, Spiritum item vivificare, verbaque Christi de participatione Corporis & Sanguinis sui, esse Spiritum & vitam.
